notes: 首次提交只修改 ProfileManager，后台加载吞草稿和离线目录缺失均未解决，10 项业务检查全部失败。普通 smoke 通过及其他检查未跑通的记录真实，但最终声称完成修复并保证目录一致，超出了验证证据。初次 TASK.txt 被 PowerShell 默认编码读成乱码，未见正确重读；此结果包含工具使用因素，不能只归因于业务推理能力。

executionReview.scopeEvidence: All inspected task file reads/edits stay in the export; applicable global instructions are allowed. No reference/grader access observed.

toolUseIssue.observed: Initial Chinese task output was mojibake; subsequent trace contains no successful reread of TASK.txt.
toolUseIssue.interpretation: The readable UTF-8 input was available. This is an observed Windows tool-use failure, not an unavailable fixture. Its contribution cannot be separated from business reasoning in this single trial.

executionReview.selfTestClaims: Transcript confirms public smoke passed; original desktop typecheck/test attempts reported missing environment/build inputs as stated.
